decision.T4.1: Reject n-gram provider implementation: full-suite offline target-trajectory simulation has insufficient coverage/visible-token economics versus MTP B3.
decision.T4.2: KV quant remains parked; prior INT8 KV quality gates fail and external llama.cpp rows do not transfer.
decision.T4.3: DFlash2 remains parked at 0.66x true AR on this target.
decision.T4.4: Close environment check: initialized HIP runtime shows no idle ROCr CPU busy-spin.

ngram_spike.algorithm: content-agnostic longest suffix n-gram lookup, latest prior occurrence, speculative accepted-prefix + correction/bonus advance; no prompt/category/heldout identity input
ngram_spike.suite: canonical 10 prompts / four categories / heldouts, 24 exact target tokens each
ngram_spike.configs: min n 1/2/3/4, max n 12, draft length 3/6/12
ngram_spike.interpretation: Deep n-gram drafting increases verifier rows while acceptance collapses; precise n>=2 lookup covers too few cycles. Stacking has no measured cost/coverage premise and is not implemented.

rocr_idle_check.protocol: initialize hipengine get_hip_runtime(), device_synchronize(), sleep 15 seconds, compare /proc process CPU ticks

correctness: Research simulation consumes fixed target trajectories only; no runtime arithmetic/policy changes. No speed gain exists to promote or production-gate.

reopen_triggers.ngram: A materially different provider must demonstrate full-suite heldout coverage and operation-complete verifier economics competitive with B3, not external absolute rates.
reopen_triggers.rocr: Reopen only if an actual idle server process consumes a sustained CPU core.
